info.name: BoiAro — Notifications API
info.description:
## Push Notification Status

✅ **Native push (FCM / APNs) is now built.**

The server delivers notifications via two channels simultaneously:
1. **In-app** — stored in `user_notifications` table, fetched by polling
2. **FCM push** — sent to all registered device tokens for the target users

FCM is **active when `FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` is set** in the server `.env`. Without it, in-app delivery still works and the push step is silently skipped.

---

## How it works

```
Mobile App (on launch)
  └─ Request push permission from OS
  └─ Get FCM token from Firebase SDK
  └─ POST /api/v1/notifications/register-token  ← register token

Admin Panel
  └─ Creates Notification (title, message, audience, type, link)
  └─ Clicks Send →
       1. Writes UserNotification rows in DB
       2. Fetches all device_push_tokens for target users
       3. Sends FCM multicast push to all tokens

Mobile App
  └─ Receives FCM push even when app is closed
  └─ GET /api/v1/notifications  (on open / pull-to-refresh)
  └─ POST /api/v1/notifications/read  (mark read)
  └─ DELETE /api/v1/notifications/register-token  (on logout)
```

---

**Base URL (production):** `https://boiaro.com.bd`
**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`

request.description:
Registers the device's FCM push token with the server so the user can receive native push notifications.

**When to call:**
- After the user grants push notification permission
- After Firebase SDK delivers a token (`getToken()` / `onTokenRefresh()`)
- On every app launch is safe — upsert avoids duplicates

**Body fields:**
```
token      String   Required. FCM registration token from Firebase SDK
platform   String   Optional. "android" (default) or "ios"
```

**Response fields:**
```
success            Boolean
push_enabled       Boolean  — always true if token was saved
firebase_configured Boolean  — true if server has FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON set
```

If `firebase_configured` is false, the token is saved but no FCM pushes will be sent until the server is configured.

Removes the device's FCM token from the server. After this, the device will no longer receive push notifications.

**When to call:**
- User logs out
- User disables push notifications in app settings

Returns the 50 most recent notifications for the authenticated user, ordered newest first.

**When to call:**
- On app open (after push tap or fresh open)
- On pull-to-refresh in the notifications screen

**Response fields:**
```
notifications[]
  id         String   — use to mark as read
  title      String
  message    String
  type       String   — general | order | promo | system | reminder | support
  link       String?  — deep link or URL to navigate to on tap
  image_url  String?  — banner image for rich notification
  is_read    Boolean
  created_at ISO 8601
```

request.description:
Marks one or more notifications as read.

**When to call:**
- User taps a specific notification
- User opens the notification detail screen

**Body:**
```
ids   string[]   Array of UserNotification IDs from the list response
```

Marks every unread notification for the current user as read.

**When to call:**
- User taps "Mark all as read"

Send an empty body `{}` — when `ids` is absent, all unread notifications are cleared.
